owner: 2026-11-22: "AI suggests lava striders on open map lol"
hypothesis: Lava Striders only lets units move over and stand in lava (and grants Made of Fire's boost after crossing it); only map 3 (LAVA_CENTER) has lava, and the Tier-2 policy is map-blind. A default seat that (A) on a map without lava never takes Lava Striders while anything else is offered, and (B) on the lava map, with fewer than two ranged stacks, takes Lava Striders when offered unless the striker rule takes Crown of Command, scores higher against the v26 default AI on each half, without losing more than 8 points on its changed tasks against owner-shaped rushes.

candidate.rule: league-drafts14.ts RUSH_T2_MAP=1 on top of RUSH_T2=h1 (production Tier-2 rule), entrant seat MG:mix:0.5:2 (v26 draft)
candidate.control: league-drafts14.ts RUSH_T2=h1 without RUSH_T2_MAP (identical to league-drafts13)
candidate.draftEnv: RUSH_VALUES explore/table-a.json RUSH_PRIOR 0.5 RUSH_VAL_SLOTS B1234 RUSH_T1 policy RUSH_T2 h1 RUSH_MM mm/model-20261122.json RUSH_MM_PRIOR mm/matchups-20261122.jsonl

development.census: 26,894 control games: Lava Striders offered 22% on every map; chosen 9.2% (map 1), 9.6% (map 3), 10.1% (map 4) of games
development.counterfactualPairs: 539 tasks with Lava Striders and another Tier-2 both played: other minus Lava Striders, armies with <2 ranged: map 1 +6.7 (n=165, 95% +0.1..+13.4), map 4 +13.1 (n=144, +5.0..+21.4), map 3 -13.3 (n=109, -23.4..-3.5); map 3 with >=2 ranged +3.2 (n=31); map 3 vs Crown +3.0 (n=18)
development.draftCheck: confirmation-Z mirror tasks (no fights): the candidate changes the Tier-2 artifact on 62 of 963 tasks (6.4%), no army changes, no rule violations

bank.allocator: allocate_v36.py (SCAN 120,000). Own capsules block every reserved channel, the 128-channel expansion of every draft preimage and the one or two channels of every setup/reverse/terrain preimage (their recipe); preimages of unknown role keep the 128-channel expansion. Before it, allocate_v34 (namespace lava-map-artifact-20261122-v1, SCAN 600,000) found only 328 eligible draft roots under the old rule, which expanded every preimage of every role, and allocate_v35 admitted only 381 families (328 + 53 of seeds15); both stay reserved and unfunded
bank.design: one draft root per family; maps 1/3/4 x 3 fight seeds per family; doctrines cycle by family
bank.selection: mirror = every task; own = families i%3==0; played = changed tasks + up to 30 unchanged parity tasks per population

arms.settings: HOC_RESEARCH_FIX_SEATS=both HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_SEARCH='{}' life-pool14.sh, spec am-prod-prod, tree prod21c6 (as confirmation Z)
arms.tags: cfV-<population>-control and cfV-<population>-candidate (changed + parity tasks), cfV-g5 on x3d (30 changed mirror candidate tasks)

analysis.unit: paired score difference per task (0 for an unchanged task), points
analysis.interval: bootstrap over draft-root families (nine tasks each), 20,000 resamples, seed 20261122
analysis.halves: no-lava = maps 1 and 4 (rule A), lava = map 3 (rule B); the halves change disjoint tasks

gates.V1: no-lava strength: lower bound of the 95% interval of the mirror tasks on maps 1 and 4 above 0
gates.V2: lava strength: lower bound of the 95% interval of the mirror tasks on map 3 above 0
gates.V3: owner-rush guard: own population, changed tasks: difference at least -8 points
gates.V4: quality: candidate games with a quality error at most control (same tasks) + 2
gates.V5: parity: every parity task replays to its control digest
gates.V6: second host: the 30 G5 candidate tasks reproduce the digests on x3d

adoption: rule A is adopted when V1 and V3-V6 pass; rule B when V2 and V3-V6 pass; a failed half stays recorded as failed and is not adopted
notClaimed: A win rate against people; seats whose map is unknown at the Tier-2 pick are unchanged.
